assessor: RTS implementation preflight — Child C incremental resumable intelligence compiler
completion_conditions: Raw record exists before any job manifest.
First incomplete chunk resumes without recomputing completed chunks.
Failed chunk retries then quarantines independently.
Learning failure never flips completed main work.
Full-corpus reevaluation requires an explicit reason.
C reaches COMPLETED while D-E remain FROZEN/NOT_APPROVED.

data_migration.notes: No existing memory/history store is rewritten.

existing_assumptions: Child A and B are COMPLETED.
Completed main work is authoritative input and learning is downstream.
Raw outcome/evidence can be fingerprinted deterministically.
rationale: Repository-local compiler with explicit raw ingest, deterministic chunk manifest, per-chunk result checkpoint, first-incomplete resume, bounded retry/quarantine, idempotency keys, differential reevaluation and proposal-only authority. Main task completion is immutable from learning failures.
risks: Crash can occur between result write and manifest update; recovery must adopt a valid orphan result.
rollback_boundary: Revert Child C package/sample/tests/docs/lifecycle only; preserve completed A/B and raw source outcomes.
